equal_call_mixture: secondary allocation-quality decomposition before gate cost
physical_claim_rule: Use the fine frozen coarsened-exact bins as primary physical matching. Call the policy contact-aware only if matched contact-minus-noncontact calls and exact-total-analytic prediction benefit are both positive with clustered 95% CI lower > 0.
primary_endpoint: raw latent mean squared error per transition

primary_exact_total_flop_comparator.definition: Strongest transition-independent convex mixture from the V4 aggregate fixed-exit loss vector at adaptive solver calls plus adaptive gate feature/normalization/head/control FLOPs converted to fractional expected later-adapter calls.
primary_exact_total_flop_comparator.integer: MILP-optimal depth counts at ceil(fractional total calls), hash-seeded assignment independent of transition data; residual baseline-minus-adaptive FLOPs reported
primary_exact_total_flop_comparator.integer_rounding: ceiling, conservatively granting the baseline weakly more compute

raw_required: exact-total-FLOP hash-seeded conservative integer mixture CI lower > 0
score permutation does not significantly beat its own exact-total analytic or seeded baseline
adaptive is nondominated on realized block-call and fully counted FLOP frontiers

verdicts.v4_confirmatory_failed: any primary raw/compute criterion fails, whitening is negative, or no replication
verdicts.v4_confirmatory_invalid: freshness, leakage, preregistration, target-access, checkpoint, exact-call, or mechanical audit failure
verdicts.v4_confirmatory_passed: all raw/validity/compute criteria and whitened CI lower > 0
verdicts.v4_confirmatory_raw_only: all raw/validity/compute criteria; whitened point positive, CI crosses zero

whitening.failure: whitened point < 0 or any raw/compute criterion fails
whitening.raw_only: all raw criteria pass and whitened point > 0 but CI includes 0
